variants.bio:
Luther Artwright is the main protagonist of Needlem0use Series. He was a human who was murdered and transported into a Sonic game where the vengeful spirit of his former friend, Sarah Henderson, resided in order to be together forever. Luther appears as a orange Fox with blue eyes, blue streaks, white gloves with black wrist sections, blue and white shoes with black rings and a blue scarf. He has no mouth and typically has a serious expression.

In his old appearance he has no scarf or blue streaks, white wrist section, and a soulless smile. He is also cross-eyed.
